title: Conversation - Data API
description: Represents a conversation between an end user and an agent. Available in API version 49.0 and later.

ConversationChannelId.description: The record ID of the channel used to initialize the conversation. This can either be a messaging channel for the Messaging product or a call center for the Service Cloud Voice product. Available in API version 50.0 and later.Service Cloud Voice is now Salesforce Voice. You may see references to Service Cloud Voice in Salesforce applications and documentation.

ConversationIdentifier.description: A unique identifier generated for the conversation.

EndTime.description: The date and time that a conversation ends.

Name.properties: Autonumber, Defaulted on create, Filter, idLookup, Sort
Name.description: The autogenerated name of the conversation.

StartTime.description: The date and time that a conversation starts.

wsdl_segment:
```xml
<complexType name="Conversation">
  <complexContent>
    <extension base="ens:sObject">
      <sequence>
        <element name="ContextParamMaps" nillable="true" minOccurs="0" type="tns:QueryResult"/>
        <element name="ConvEntries" nillable="true" minOccurs="0" type="tns:QueryResult"/>
        <element name="ConversationChannelId" nillable="true" minOccurs="0" type="tns:ID"/>
        <element name="ConversationEntries" nillable="true" minOccurs="0" type="tns:QueryResult"/>
        <element name="ConversationIdentifier" nillable="true" minOccurs="0" type="xsd:string"/>
        <element name="ConversationParticipants" nillable="true" minOccurs="0" type="tns:QueryResult"/>
        <element name="CreatedBy" nillable="true" minOccurs="0" type="ens:User"/>
        <element name="CreatedById" nillable="true" minOccurs="0" type="tns:ID"/>
        <element name="CreatedDate" nillable="true" minOccurs="0" type="xsd:dateTime"/>
        <element name="EndTime" nillable="true" minOccurs="0" type="xsd:dateTime"/>
        <element name="EndTimeMilliSecs" nillable="true" minOccurs="0" type="xsd:int"/>
        <element name="IsDeleted" nillable="true" minOccurs="0" type="xsd:boolean"/>
        <element name="LastModifiedBy" nillable="true" minOccurs="0" type="ens:User"/>
        <element name="LastModifiedById" nillable="true" minOccurs="0" type="tns:ID"/>
        <element name="LastModifiedDate" nillable="true" minOccurs="0" type="xsd:dateTime"/>
        <element name="Name" nillable="true" minOccurs="0" type="xsd:string"/>
        <element name="StartTime" nillable="true" minOccurs="0" type="xsd:dateTime"/>
        <element name="StartTimeMilliSecs" nillable="true" minOccurs="0" type="xsd:int"/>
      </sequence>
    </extension>
  </complexContent>
</complexType>
<simpleType name="ID">
  <restriction base="xsd:string">
    <length value="18"/>
    <pattern value="[a-zA-Z0-9]{18}"/>
  </restriction>
</simpleType>
<simpleType name="QueryLocator">
  <restriction base="xsd:string"/>
</simpleType>
<complexType name="QueryResult">
  <sequence>
    <element name="done" type="xsd:boolean"/>
    <element name="queryLocator" type="tns:QueryLocator" nillable="true"/>
    <element name="records" type="ens:sObject" nillable="true" minOccurs="0" maxOccurs="unbounded"/>
    <element name="size" type="xsd:int"/>
  </sequence>
</complexType>
```

EndTimeMilliSecs.field_label: Milliseconds portion of Conversation End time

StartTimeMilliSecs.field_label: Milliseconds portion of Conversation Start time
